en: Hi, glad to meet you!\p…That's unfriendly of you.\nHow about saying hi back?\pSo, come on, tell me about\nyourself.\pI'd love to hear your profile!
Tell me something good about\nyourself. What's your profile?

A profile is written using four
words or phrases.\pThere're plenty of words to choose
from for your profile.\pThe words and phrases are placed
in several convenient groups.\pFirst, choose a group, then choose
a word or phrase.\p…It's easier than it sounds.
Why don't you try it?
Aww… Don't be like that.\nYou can tell me your profile.
Oh, you've decided not to?\nYou're fickle, aren't you?
Would you like to change your\nprofile?
What are you like now?\nI'd really like to know.
Okay, you like your profile the\nway it is.\pI think so, too.
Hmhm…\pYour profile really says something\nabout who you are.\pNow that I know you better, it \nmakes us better friends than ever!
Oh, I've heard that before…\pMy cousin, who lives far away,\nalways used to say that, I think.
Please tell me more about\nyourself next time!
